scope: Corollary 1.2 (Uniform cotype bounds and entropy duality) of the manuscript “The cotype–cotype conjecture under the approximation property” (preprints/The-cotype-cotype-conjecture-under-the-approximation-property-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 326 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c2f55fe9562e2ee7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix q, r ∈ [2, ∞) and C, D ∈ [1, ∞). There is a finite constant κ = κ(q, r, C, D) such that every nonzero real Banach space X with AP and Cq(X) ≤ C, Cr(X∗ ) ≤ D satisfies K(X) ≤ κ. Consequently there are a, b ≥ 1, depending only on q, r, C, D, such that for every n ≥ 1, all origin-symmetric convex bodies K, L ⊂ ℝn, and every t > 0, 1 b log N(L◦ , atK◦ ) ≤ log N(K, tL) ≤ b log N(L◦ , a−1 tK◦ ), (1.2) provided either XK or XL satisfies the displayed primal and dual cotype bounds.
